svg.title: Forest · Energy · Data — a self-reinforcing 25-year cycle
svg.desc: Three nodes — native forest restoration, locally generated renewable energy, and community-owned data center — each feeding the others, bound together by a shared 25-year ledger of methods, data, and outcomes.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about native forest restoration in Mitsue village and how it connects to EV charging and community energy resilience')
sendPrompt('How does locally generated solar and battery energy connect forest restoration to the data center and EV charging in Mitsue?')
sendPrompt('What is the community-owned micro data center concept for Mitsue elementary school?')
